visual.name: slopeChart
visual.description: Two-period and multi-period comparison done right: slope, dumbbell and bump views, labels that never overlap, rise/fall/flat colouring with a threshold, change annotations, focus, story headline and small multiples — from two measures or one measure plus a Period column. Part of the SmartVisuals visual family for Power BI.
